title: fix: invalidate stale KPI cache entries
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Bumps the KPI Tinybird cache key version
- Invalidates existing six-hour edge entries
- Makes the new 30-minute TTL effective immediately

gist.headline: The KPI clock got reset
gist.blurb: The dashboard's old six-hour memory has been gently swept out. Fresh KPI data can now settle into its intended 30-minute rhythm.
gist.summary: Bumped the KPI Tinybird cache-key version so existing six-hour edge-cache entries are invalidated and the new 30-minute TTL takes effect immediately.
gist.impact: Users will see KPI dashboards refresh on the new 30-minute schedule instead of being held by previously cached six-hour responses.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a cozy timekeeper in a small garden dashboard, replacing an oversized stale six-hour sandglass with a fresh 30-minute pixel timer beside a glowing KPI monitor. Tiny code-plants and flowers represent metrics becoming current again.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and a tiny clockmaker apron, resetting a glowing 30-minute pixel timer beside a retro KPI monitor while an old six-hour sandglass is tucked away; code-plants and small flowers grow around the desk. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with subtle pixel-font text: '30 MIN'. Nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
